rows.sourceMeaning: A claim about a field geometry revision and its filing scope; the assertion does not create or accept that revision.
A measured stand-count/emergence observation may support a typed compliance criterion; an operation claim requires evidence that counting was performed, not merely that a count exists.
Hail damage is a non-deliberate occurrence. A compliance claim may describe its scope or relevance without alleging a deliberate hail operation.
Deliberate crop removal; produced-lot creation remains a linked material consequence and does not replace the harvest meaning.
Separate typed split and dispatch propositions, joined conjunctively if both alleged; old/new lot lineage and dispatch movement are distinct facts.
Evidentiary receipt/attachment of a lab report; it says nothing by itself about the analyte result, compliance, or when sampling occurred.
A formal inspection closure/correction act may be context for a pending allegation about decision applicability; the allegation does not issue or change a decision.
Physical action described by the source; report/capture/as-applied status is retained as a qualification, not substituted for the world action.
Physical action described by the source; report/capture/as-applied status is retained as a qualification, not substituted for the world action.
An envelope can legitimately omit subtype. New pack meanings remain expressible through an explicit revisioned case; omission, null, unknown and a changed sentence are distinct inputs.

The language must express planting, tillage, fertilization, spraying, irrigation, pruning, harvest, sanitation/cleanout, maintenance and material handling with exact target, material, equipment, quantity, extent and qualifiers.

meaningMappings.meaning: Place specified seed/planting material to establish the named cultivation attempt, preserving seed lot, crop/variety, seed rate, extent and replant lineage.
Perform the named soil/crop cultivation method on the exact extent; depth, passes and equipment parameters are retained when alleged.
Apply a specified fertilizer/material with explicit nutrient versus product quantity and extent; active nutrient and whole product are not interchangeable.
Apply the specified crop-protection product to the stated target/extent by the stated method, preserving product, pest/target, dose/rate and application-volume meaning.
Deliver water through a named method to a specified target/extent, preserving water amount, rate/flow or depth interpretation and relevant time.
Remove selected canopy/plant material by a named pruning method on an explicit target/extent, retaining intent versus performance, occurrence facet and partial-work qualifications.
Remove crop material from the specified field/cycle/extent, naming output lot/material links and quantities when claimed; removal and accepted lot creation are separate.
Apply a specified cleaning/sanitation procedure to named equipment, tool, container, facility or extent; the performed procedure and its achieved hygiene criterion are separate.
Apply a specified cleaning/sanitation procedure to named equipment, tool, container, facility or extent; the performed procedure and its achieved hygiene criterion are separate.
Perform a specified maintenance task on an exact equipment/tool/facility/container asset, preserving replaced parts, configuration and task-completion facet; this need not change durable identity.

Allege that a specified traceability cohort was established, or is intended to be established, by a named origin process. The prospective lot is a described output; the claim does not allocate a canonical identity, create an accepted MaterialEvent consequence, or write inventory.
Separate one coherent cohort into two or more successor cohorts, preserving predecessor/successors and quantities where alleged.
Governedly unite distinct lots into one successor cohort with explicit source lineage; this meaning differs from physical commingling.
Move named material from source to destination, with custody/possession roles and commercial references separately stated; location change alone does not create a new lot.
Move named material from source to destination, with custody/possession roles and commercial references separately stated; location change alone does not create a new lot.

The identified receiver takes physical delivery of the specified material/cohort at the receiving location for the declared extent. Receipt, dispatch, commercial acceptance, custody and title are distinct allegations.

An actor alleges reassignment of a material classification under an exact versioned scheme and procedure, retaining before/after class and traceability claim basis. A label change does not silently create, transform or continue a cohort.

An actor alleges removal of a specified material extent from its declared use/inventory route by the named disposal procedure and destination. Disposal is not movement, reclassification, or a successor-producing transformation.

rows.sourceMeaning: Retain all nine profiles and seventeen eligible event-presence/profile cells. Exact time selectors follow the body meaning; neither a report timestamp nor a conveniently equal number chooses the perspective.
A sampled observation of the action itself, with a result defined as occurred/not occurred or a method-defined process measurement tied to that action.
Collection of the identified specimen under a named sampling protocol on the stated support; pending analysis can coexist with a retained collection allegation.

A result-production act may be alleged only when the property/context explicitly describes producing that result at the selected phenomenon instant. This is a proposed compatibility definition, not a reinterpretation of every measurement resultTime.
Recording/ingesting can be the intended meaning of an operation allegation when the measurement property describes that recording act; it cannot establish the time of the reported physical work.
An allegation may retain an estimated instant only as an explicitly qualified estimate with its uncertainty basis. It is not an exact observed-time assertion.

An omitted optional foreign qualifier is not OBSERVED_TIME by default. An exact method/profile interpretation may define a unique phenomenon-time role for these bytes; otherwise the performance basis is unresolved.
Quantified measurement with explicit kind and unit; a number does not intrinsically signify an operation.
An exact result code under an identified revisioned concept scheme.
Preserved qualitative content with a bounded interpretation for the selected use.
A qualified detection/quantification result, not a precise substituted number.
No result yet; may preserve a separately evidenced sample collection.
collect-sample at 2026-05-06T10:05:00Z on composite support; analysis pending
qualified sample nitrate result, BELOW_LOQ 2 mg/kg; result issued May 8 about May 6 sample
18 weeds/m2 over the observed patch and observation interval; local method/uncertainty retained
7.5 hours leaf wetness over a stated observation interval with instrument and calibration context
A coherent measured claim retains all context that changes what was measured, where, when, by whom, how and with what limitations. Schema validity is not evidence sufficiency or authority.
Use existing method/unit/profile machinery without pretending that example refs are governed observed-operation concepts.
An operation mentioned by the event targets the field/crop-cycle/lot stated in its exact linked execution payload.
The identified specimen was collected from a precisely identified support within a target, not necessarily representative of all of that target.
A sampled, observed, treated, failed-pass, retreatment, replant or damage extent relates to its parent for a declared time/use without becoming a new durable identity.
A report concerns a specimen, measured property and supported target via declared report/sample/context relations. Report ingestion is not the result itself.
A formal decision concerns an exact reviewed artifact, whose typed subject and applicable scope must then be resolved; anchors alone do not identify the reviewed domain subject.
Revision, split, merge, replacement, succession, overlap and derivation retain their different directions and identity implications.
The same real asset may participate in many operations; maintenance/configuration changes do not replace its identity. Equipment evidence is not performer authority.
A lot may occupy a reusable container or storage location for one episode; changing occupancy does not create a new container or automatically create a new lot.
Party-to-party, party-to-scope and external-document links retain their enumerated context/basis meanings and never grant permission or prove physical operation performance.
A Field belongs to its explicitly bound parent Farm; a CropCycle is one cultivation attempt on its explicit parent scope set. These are directed domain links, not permission inheritance.

The nine-kind draft cannot losslessly carry all accepted identity requirements. Preserve the nine existing kinds and propose explicit additional subject/context kinds rather than mislabel assets or containment units.

The existing draft binds proofs immutably but does not define their truth. Consume actual owner-produced evidence under its own contract; do not add a generic compatible flag or parallel evidence ledger.

resolutions: The supplied spot-spray event is reconciled as physical spraying described by a late report. O01/O19 consume V04-spray; O16 reporting and O23 ingestion require their own act evidence/event. No old frozen file is rewritten.

Sample collection with pending analysis is O10 + V05-time-sample + V05-source-sample_pending + V06-sample-target. The analyte remains soil nitrate; collection provenance supplies the collection meaning. No synthetic occurrence code replaces ABSENT_PENDING.

S12–S14 and V06-endpoints agree on four additional subject/context kinds and separate SAMPLE/PARTIAL_EXTENT/DOCUMENT/REVIEW_DECISION/INSPECTION_RECORD evidence endpoints. Existing authority anchors remain unchanged.

Completion-at-an-instant is a newly explicit facet in this domain candidate. V05 observed occurrence must be specialized by the exact bound work/procedure completion criterion and extent; an interval end or progress observation alone cannot establish it. W03/W04 are fictional dedicated completion observations, not a conversion of the actual pruning/spraying interval examples.
No actual governed/admitted measured-performance positive is established. Candidate definition hashes identify review text only; they never fill governedBinding or replace actual proof authority.
B01–B04 repaired under candidate r3: exact material-action mapping, scoped quantity collection, unified atoms and guarded profile/facet definitions. Canonical source bytes unchanged.
r4 repairs only application-material interpretation/identity and the O22 output-by-facet guard. Canonical contribution and all mappings remain unchanged.

SEMANTICS.owner: AssertionRecord body/domain owner with relevant evidence/pack owner
SEMANTICS.deliverable: Review and adopt exact candidate concept, predicate and body revision; materialize its actual immutable bytes/hash. Current identifiers below are local proposal identifiers only.
SEMANTICS.boundary: Domain meaning; no new authority granted

EVENT.deliverable: Actual separately passing evidence binds exact envelope bytes, dominant-consequence classification, authoritative primary family and selected assertion commit class. Pair with the adopted body meaning case; neither substitutes for the other.

MEASUREMENT.deliverable: Actual immutable property/result/method interpretation, qualified observation or collection provenance, time/extent/subject links and eligible-use evidence. No admitted operation-occurrence dictionary or complete governed positive is present in the inspected sources.

RELATION.owner: Existing identity/lifecycle and subject-context evidence owners
RELATION.deliverable: Admitted relation evidence for the row-specific carrier endpoints, direction, applicability and extent; exact producer/contract revision and digest must be supplied, not inferred from a ref or flag.

ENDPOINTS.owner: AssertionRecord body/domain owner; authority scope owner only if scope law must change
ENDPOINTS.deliverable: Proposed explicit EQUIPMENT, TOOL, STORAGE_LOCATION, CONTAINER subject/context kinds and SAMPLE/PARTIAL_EXTENT evidence endpoints. Revise the draft body/intent constraints consistently; do not alias them to INPUT, LOT, FIELD or FACILITY. Keep the one existing authority anchor. Any new authority-scope kind is a separate decision.

PROFILE.owner: Existing SI, RS or NL profile owner as applicable
PROFILE.deliverable: Real jurisdiction/year-specific concept, method, rule, threshold, reference snapshot and evidence eligibility bindings. Listing a requirement imports no legal rule or producer authority into Core.

PAYLOAD.owner: Existing complete domain payload/PR43 envelope owner
PAYLOAD.deliverable: Full 49-obligation domain payload with actual contract/schema/intent/result digests and selected body binding; observed relationships/measurements feed named leaves. PR45 copy MATCH and a self-authored boolean are not substitutes.
